text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] billing.metering — delayed emits detected in ingest-aggregator (eu-west). Over/under flags firing for ~120 customers. Pager: SEV3. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-delay
sre-ellen: acked — I'm oncall, starting triage.
billing-jordan: seeing customer overage emails start at 03:18 UTC, cc @cs-maya. Are these real charges or false positives?
eng-oncall: quick telemetry: emitter lag spike at 03:12 UTC, consumer backlog ~40k messages, windowing delta ~+2h vs expected. Running:
```
# check consumer lag
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-eu:9092 --describe --group metering-agg
```
ops-rob: rolling back last aggregator deploy (2026-03-17T23:50Z) now — initiating canary rollback to v2.3.1
sre-ellen: pausing shadow-emits to billing-shadow (non-prod) and disabling overage alerting for 1h while we stabilize. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/flags/emit_pause -d '{"scope":"eu","reason":"incident-1744449999"}'
```
incident-bot: oncall handoff reminder -> infra-lina in 15m
infra-lina: taking over triage. spinning +3 consumer instances to drain backlog, tailing agg logs.
billing-jordan: CS reports 6 customers already received overage emails and one ticket opened. These look like false positives (counts inflated). Preparing temporary credits list.
cs-maya: created ticket INC-9874 for customer outreach, template drafted, will send once we confirm mitigation. :pray:
eng-oncall: initial hypothesis: duplicate delta emission when consumer rebalances; duplicate emit_id for some windows causing token double-counts. Instrumenting dedupe metrics and increasing log verbosity for aggregator.apply_delta.
billing-jordan: quick patch ready: add emit_id dedupe during window apply + idempotency guard. Plan: canary 10% traffic on agg-instance-7.
ops-rob: canary started on agg-instance-7 — logs show duplicate keys filtered; metric metering.duplicates dropped from ~15k/min -> ~200/min.
pm-ash: (pm) confirm we hold any billing until we run reconciliation? We should avoid charging while counts unstable.
billing-jordan: confirmed — hold automatic billing runs for affected windows. Manual reconciliation and credits will be applied post-replay.
infra-lina: backlog down to ~8k, emit-rate back to baseline. Paused overage alerting in alertmanager for eu region during the stabilizing window.
sre-ellen: mitigation looks effective. Next steps: run a replay job overnight to rebuild aggregates from raw events, then reconcile customer counts and apply credits. Assign follow-ups in INC-9874.
cs-maya: noted — will wait for reconciliation before outbound comms. I'll flag priority customers.
incident-bot: UPDATE: mitigated — SEV3 -> MONITORING. Handing post-incident to billing-jordan for crediting + postmortem. Full notes & links: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1744449999
